card.name: The word every in dosing intervals
card.fires_on: The word "every" right after a verb or route phrase, where it begins a repeat interval such as "every 8 hours" or "every day". It also fires on "every" in general web phrases of the same kind.

modes.label: Dose interval
modes.description: "every" follows a drug, route or monitoring phrase and precedes a number of hours, days or months.
modes.example: mg intravenously<< every>> 6 hours. Continue dexameth

modes.label: Everyday web phrasing
modes.description: "every" follows a verb in general text and means a regular repeat, such as each day.
modes.example: Learn something new<< every>> day More Info... by email A

card.writes: It adds little beyond favoring the word "every" itself, with some weak pull toward "possible".
card.plain: It lights up on the word "every" when it sets how often something is given or repeated.
